meta.name: xAPI verbs
meta.about: The six xAPI verbs HAX elements send and which of 28 elements sends each, generated from user-action/lib/xapi-vocabulary.json. Green elements count toward completion.

v_experienced.desc: The learner opened or saw it. Never required for completion. Sent by 6 elements.

v_attempted.desc: The learner started it. Sent by 9 elements.

v_progressed.desc: The learner got part way; media and multi-step activities report progress. Sent by 9 elements.

v_completed.desc: The learner finished it as the element defines done. Sent by 12 elements.

v_answered.desc: The learner gave an answer; result carries success and the response. Sent by 15 elements.

v_interacted.desc: The learner did something with it that is not an answer. Sent by 3 elements.

x_a11y_collapse.desc: Sends experienced on user-engagement. Done means: opened by the learner (one already open when the page loads has nothing to open and does not count) Counts toward completion.

x_a11y_media_player.desc: Sends attempted, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: 95% of the media actually watched, or played on into the end after watching 80% (seeking ahead does not count) Counts toward completion.
x_a11y_media_player.note: object type media; result: completion, duration, extensions.https://w3id.org/xapi/video/extensions/progress

x_audio_player.desc: Sends attempted, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: 95% of the media actually watched, or played on into the end after watching 80% (seeking ahead does not count) Counts toward completion.
x_audio_player.note: object type media; result: completion, duration, extensions.https://w3id.org/xapi/video/extensions/progress

x_bullet_check_list.desc: Sends progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: every item ticked Counts toward completion.
x_bullet_check_list.note: object type objective; result: completion, response, score

x_concept_map_game.desc: Sends attempted, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: game completed Counts toward completion.
x_concept_map_game.note: object type simulation; result: success, completion, response, score, duration

x_concept_quest_game.desc: Sends attempted, answered, completed on user-engagement. Done means: game completed Counts toward completion.
x_concept_quest_game.note: object type simulation; result: success, completion, response, score, duration

x_concept_runner_game.desc: Sends attempted, answered, completed on user-engagement. Done means: game completed Counts toward completion.
x_concept_runner_game.note: object type simulation; result: success, completion, response, score, duration

x_fill_in_the_blanks.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_fill_in_the_blanks.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_flash_card.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly Counts toward completion.
x_flash_card.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score

x_h5p_element.desc: Sends attempted, answered, completed on user-engagement. Done means: never required; not every H5P content type reports completion Does not count toward completion.
x_h5p_element.note: object type interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, duration

x_haxcms_page.desc: Sends experienced, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: page content scrolled through to its end (each page counts its reading toward being done on its own) Does not count toward completion.
x_haxcms_page.note: object type lesson; result: completion, duration, extensions.https://haxtheweb.org/xapi/extensions/progress

x_image_compare_slider.desc: Sends interacted on user-engagement. Done means: never required; records that the learner moved the slider Does not count toward completion.

x_lrndesign_imagemap.desc: Sends progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: never required; completed once every hotspot has been opened Does not count toward completion.
x_lrndesign_imagemap.note: object type interaction; result: completion, score

x_lrs_emitter.desc: Sends experienced, interacted, answered, progressed, attempted, completed on user-engagement. Done means: never; records the authored verb when clicked or viewed Does not count toward completion.

x_mark_the_words.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_mark_the_words.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_matching_question.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_matching_question.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_multiple_choice.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_multiple_choice.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_reading_analysis.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: every expected flag placed with no wrong ones (or the right passage selected), or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_reading_analysis.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_self_check.desc: Sends experienced on user-engagement. Done means: the answer has been revealed Counts toward completion.

x_self_reflective_nudge.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: a response was chosen Counts toward completion.
x_self_reflective_nudge.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: completion, response

x_short_answer_question.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_short_answer_question.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_slide_deck.desc: Sends attempted, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: never required; completed once every slide has been shown Does not count toward completion.
x_slide_deck.note: object type interaction; result: completion, score

x_sorting_question.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_sorting_question.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_tagging_question.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_tagging_question.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_true_false_question.desc: Sends answered on user-engagement. Done means: answered correctly or out of attempts Counts toward completion.
x_true_false_question.note: object type cmi.interaction; result: success, completion, response, score, extensions.attempts, extensions.max-attempts

x_user_action.desc: Sends experienced, interacted on user-engagement. Done means: never; records that something was seen (visibility) or used (click, keypress) Does not count toward completion.

x_video_player.desc: Sends attempted, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: 95% of the media actually watched, or played on into the end after watching 80% (seeking ahead does not count) Counts toward completion.
x_video_player.note: object type media; result: completion, duration, extensions.https://w3id.org/xapi/video/extensions/progress

x_vocab_term.desc: Sends experienced on user-engagement. Done means: never required; records that the definition was opened Does not count toward completion.

tours.label: What learners generate
tours.message: Six verbs, 28 elements that send them, all from one vocabulary file so every statement is shaped the same way.

scenes.caption: Every HAX activity speaks xAPI through one shared vocabulary.
Six verbs cover everything an element reports.
Attempted, progressed, completed: media, games and multi-step activities.
Experienced and interacted: things a learner opened or touched.
Statements feed Insights and describe learning in a course.
